label: Channel (Sync Gateway)
type: core Sync Gateway access-control primitive - a freeform, uncataloged label documents are tagged with by the sync function; users/roles gain read access to a document by being granted membership of its channel(s)
note: Unlike privilege:query-manage-index or capella-role:*, there is no fixed enum of channels - they are created implicitly by the sync function assigning documents to them. See relations/grants-channel-access.json.
